I expected them to try and take over our mining field, just not this soon.|[[A'Lerris Verata]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:TAZO">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|The Awakened: Zynt'aia Order|Tatoo system}}</ref>}}
'''Nallera's Mining Field''' was a region of space in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="SWG:NMF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space_poi|Nallera's Mining Field|Tatoo system}}</ref> It contained an asteroid field that was discovered and mined during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TAZO" />

==History==
Stemming from the system's outermost reaches, Nallera's Mining Field remained one of Tatooine's oldest [[Mining/Legends|mining]] outposts. Nallera's Mining Field was far enough from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' influence, but close enough to [[Tatooine Space Station|Tatooine's space station]] to encourage trade and ship goods to the planet. The inhabitants of Nallera's Mining Field were friendly and welcomed travelers to their [[Nallera's Mining Station|outpost]].<ref name="SWG:NMF" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the area was mined by a [[Nallera's mining crew|mining crew]] led by [[A'Lerris Verata]], despite the attacks of the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians|Zynt'aia pirates]].<ref name="SWG:TAZO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nallera's Mining Field appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NMF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nallera's Mining Field was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:NMF" />
